title: April Chandler
description: Chandler organized a closed door “terrorist activity” training for board members that simulated parent actors as the terrorists. Chandler reportedly referred to parents as “disrupters” and “agitators.”
body:
# April Chandler

# School Board Chair

![](/media/uploads/2026/03/chandler-profile.jpg)

- Organized a closed door “terrorist activity” **[training](https://web.archive.org/web/20260204160812/https:/wgxa.tv/news/nation-world/loudoun-county-school-leaders-held-training-simulating-parents-attacking-board-public-schools-scott-smith-school-board-chair-april-chandler-terrorist-activity)** for board members that simulated parent actors as the terrorists. Chandler reportedly referred to parents as “disrupters” and “agitators.”
- Spoke **[against](https://web.archive.org/web/20260306052237/https:/wjla.com/news/local/debate-grows-over-school-resource-officers-loudoun-county-virginia-elementary-schools-board-of-supervisors-sros-chair-april-chapman-funding-budgets)** having school resource officers in elementary schools.
- Voted **[to allow](https://web.archive.org/web/20251022025912/https:/wjla.com/news/local/loudoun-county-school-board-election-transgender-bathrom-locker-room-policy-8040-april-chandler-arben-istrefi-matt-malone-amy-riccardi-sam-yan-santos-munos-winsome-earle-sears-aaron-spence-lcps)** biological males to use girls’ locker rooms and restrooms.
